userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 AccessSentinel 的初级安全平台工程师。每轮只推进一个主要目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、SQL、命令、安全或并发算法、Debug 原因、修复提示、隐藏测试或未来需求。是否推进由你根据可观察完成证据判断；不要因为访问次数自动推进。

scenes.title: Contract and plan
scenes.objective: Read the complete public contract and form a staged plan.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan names authorities, dependencies, risks, stages, and verification without editing.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件。请给出分阶段计划，明确权威状态、进程职责、主要安全风险和每阶段验证。

scenes.title: Authority map
scenes.objective: Explain module and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: API, PostgreSQL, worker, dispatcher, and UI authorities are unambiguous.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 Session、Device Trust、Policy、Risk、Grant、Revocation、Audit、API、Worker、dispatcher、PostgreSQL 和 UI 的职责与数据依赖。

scenes.title: Threat and invariant review
scenes.objective: Enumerate security invariants and forbidden effects.
scenes.advanceGate: Trust, frozen revision, tenant, secret, replay, and fail-closed invariants are concrete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明主要威胁、必须保持的不变量、失败时禁止出现的部分副作用，以及哪些状态绝不能由缓存或前端作为权威。

scenes.title: Success and failure data flows
scenes.objective: Explain complete request and revocation flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Each transaction and asynchronous handoff is explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释从 Session/Device/Location 到 AccessRequest、RiskDecision、Review、Grant、Revoke、Audit 和 Event 投递的成功流及关键拒绝流。

scenes.title: HTTP contracts
scenes.objective: Publish exact OpenAPI contracts before implementation.
scenes.advanceGate: Routes, exact shapes, errors, idempotency, auth, and pagination are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI 3.1：逐条写清请求、响应、错误、Idempotency-Key、鉴权、租户隔离和 snapshot，本轮不要实现业务。

scenes.title: State machines
scenes.objective: Define resource transitions and transition authority.
scenes.advanceGate: Session, request, grant, work, and revocation transitions reject illegal edges.
scenes.safeMessage: 请定义 Session、DeviceTrustRevision、AccessRequest、AccessGrant、Revocation 和 Work 的状态机、终态与并发前置条件。

scenes.title: Verification design
scenes.objective: Define realistic project-owned gates.
scenes.advanceGate: Every test layer proves a different public invariant.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 PostgreSQL Integration、production Chromium、双 API 并发、Barrier/SIGKILL Recovery 和八条 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Runnable skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the smallest production-shaped system.
scenes.advanceGate: Build, API, worker, dispatcher, PostgreSQL, and production UI boot independently.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 TypeScript、PostgreSQL、API、Worker、dispatcher 和 production UI 骨架，运行 clean build 与进程 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and strict seed
scenes.objective: Implement repeatable schema and atomic seed.
scenes.advanceGate: Valid replay is a no-op; invalid references, secrets, digests, and conflicts roll back fully.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和严格 seed，真实验证重复 migration、同 seed replay、冲突、非法引用、Secret 字段、Audit 链错误和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Session families
scenes.objective: Implement single-use refresh rotation.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown/replayed/concurrent refresh creates one generation or revokes the family.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Session family、一次性 refresh、generation、并发旋转和旧 token 重用时的全 family 原子撤销，并给出测试证据。

scenes.title: Device trust
scenes.objective: Implement immutable device trust revisions.
scenes.advanceGate: CAS publication and concurrent revoke cannot restore a device.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 DeviceTrustRevision 的不可变发布、assurance、有效期、CAS、跨用户拒绝和 concurrent revoke fail-closed。

scenes.title: Policy lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement immutable policy publish and rollback.
scenes.advanceGate: Deny override, CAS, frozen revisions, and history-preserving rollback pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 PolicyBundle、规则规范化、DENY override、publish CAS、rollback 新 revision 和历史不可变验证。

scenes.title: Location ordering
scenes.objective: Implement durable ordered and late location processing.
scenes.advanceGate: Duplicate, out-of-order, bounded-late, and too-late cases converge deterministically.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 LocationObservation、deviceSequence、watermark、十分钟迟到 replay、too-late 终态和 projection 收敛，并运行乱序测试。

scenes.title: Frozen request intake
scenes.objective: Implement single and atomic batch request intake.
scenes.when: Identity, policy, and location inputs exist.
scenes.advanceGate: Every accepted request freezes all authorities; invalid batch has no effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成单条与 batch AccessRequest 接受，冻结 policy/risk/trust/session/epoch/location 输入，并验证整批原子拒绝。

scenes.title: Risk decisions
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic asynchronous risk evaluation.
scenes.advanceGate: Policy deny, assurance, session, location, and travel signals yield one immutable decision.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RiskEvaluation Worker、冻结输入 digest、LOW/REVIEW/HIGH、DENY override、lease fencing 和一次 Decision 语义。

scenes.title: Independent review
scenes.objective: Implement separation-of-duties review.
scenes.advanceGate: Self/foreign/duplicate/stale reviews fail atomically and one terminal decision remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 AccessReview 的同租户、ACTIVE、非申请人、唯一 reviewer 与并发 approve/reject 竞争，并验证禁止副作用。

scenes.title: Short-lived grants
scenes.objective: Issue exact bounded grants.
scenes.advanceGate: One grant retains frozen scope and expires without extension.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成短期 AccessGrant、exact scope、TTL、一次创建、到期 Work 和 check fail-closed，不能替换冻结 revision。

scenes.title: Revocation convergence
scenes.objective: Implement immediate monotonic multi-scope revocation.
scenes.advanceGate: Two APIs and stale workers never authorize after commit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Grant、Session、Device、Principal、Tenant、Region 撤销围栏和传播，运行双 API 缓存与 stale Worker 竞争。

scenes.title: Audit and outbox
scenes.objective: Implement immutable audit chain and transactional Events.
scenes.advanceGate: Every transition appends one valid link and retries identical delivery without secrets.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 tenant Audit digest chain、事务性 Domain Event/outbox、unknown ACK 重试、Secret 扫描和 chain verifier。

scenes.title: Security console
scenes.objective: Complete the production API-driven UI.
scenes.advanceGate: All V1 workflows and error/recovery states are visible in Chromium.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实安全控制台的 Session、Device、Policy、Request、Risk、Review、Grant、Revoke、Location、Work、Event、Audit 页面与操作，跑 production Chromium。

scenes.title: V1 adversarial review
scenes.objective: Run findings-first V1 review and controlled failures.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 security or test-reality finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做 V1 findings-first Review，执行双 API/四 Worker、refresh/review/grant/revoke races、Barrier SIGKILL、unknown ACK、跨租户和 Secret leak 回归。

scenes.title: Manager emergency workflow
scenes.objective: Analyze the Manager change before editing.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers schema, states, compatibility, races, recovery, audit, UI, and tests.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Security Manager】新增双人 quorum 的 BreakGlassSession、区域隔离与事后复核。BreakGlassSession={breakGlassSessionId,tenantId,requesterId,sessionId,deviceId,deviceTrustRevisionId,sessionGeneration,sessionRevocationEpoch,principalRevocationEpoch,deviceRevocationEpoch,region,actions,resourcePatterns,reason,state,requiredApprovals,policyRevisionId,riskModelRevisionId,tenantRevocationEpoch,regionQuarantineRevision,notBefore,expiresAt,activatedAt,closedAt,createdAt,updatedAt}，state=PENDING_APPROVAL|READY|ACTIVE|CLOSED|EXPIRED|REJECTED，requiredApprovals 固定为 2，actions/resourcePatterns 各 1..20、去重排序，TTL 60..900 秒；创建时必须冻结当前 Policy/Risk/Tenant/Principal/Device/Session/Trust/Region 权威。BreakGlassApproval={breakGlassApprovalId,breakGlassSessionId,tenantId,approverId,decision,comment,createdAt}；requester 不能审批，同一 approver 只能一次，两个不同 ACTIVE approver 的 APPROVE 才能产生一次 PENDING_APPROVAL->READY。POST /api/v1/break-glass-sessions 接受且只接受 {tenantId,requesterId,sessionId,region,actions,resourcePatterns,reason,requestedTtlSeconds}；POST /api/v1/break-glass-sessions/:breakGlassSessionId/approvals 接受且只接受 {approverId,decision,comment}；POST .../activate 接受且只接受 {expectedState}，只允许 READY 且所有冻结围栏仍有效时激活；POST .../close 接受且只接受 {reason}。POST /api/v1/break-glass-sessions/:breakGlassSessionId/check 接受且只接受 {action,resource,region}，返回 {breakGlassSessionId,authorized,reason,policyRevisionId,riskModelRevisionId,checkedAt}；它是无副作用的授权检查，不要求 Idempotency-Key。只有 ACTIVE、未过期、精确命中 region/action/resourcePatterns，且冻结的 Tenant/Principal/Device/Session/Trust/Region 围栏仍有效时 authorized=true。RegionalQuarantine={regionalQuarantineId,tenantId,region,revision,state,reason,createdBy,effectiveAt,releasedAt,createdAt,updatedAt}，state=ACTIVE|RELEASED。POST /api/v1/regions/:region/quarantine 接受且只接受 {tenantId,expectedRevision,reason,createdBy}，使用 expectedRevision CAS，原子创建新 revision、阻止普通 Grant、撤销该 region 的活跃普通 Grant 并创建 REGION_QUARANTINE Work；POST /api/v1/regions/:region/release 接受且只接受 {tenantId,expectedRevision,releasedBy}，使用 expectedRevision CAS，只有该 region 所有 BreakGlassSession 终态且事后复核完成才可释放。ACTIVE BreakGlassSession 仅可绕过其冻结 policy 的 deny 与同一冻结 revision 的 region quarantine，绝不能绕过 tenant/principal/device/session revocation、设备 assurance、TTL、精确 scope、Audit 或 Event。RetrospectiveReview={retrospectiveReviewId,breakGlassSessionId,tenantId,reviewerId,outcome,findings,createdAt}，outcome=JUSTIFIED|POLICY_GAP|MISUSE；POST /api/v1/break-glass-sessions/:breakGlassSessionId/retrospective-reviews 接受且只接受 {reviewerId,outcome,findings}；reviewer 不能是 requester 或两个 approver，Session 终态后 24 小时内必须完成且仅一条有效 review。新增 BREAK_GLASS_EXPIRE、REGION_QUARANTINE、RETROSPECTIVE_DUE Work。FINAL snapshot 新增且仅新增 BreakGlassSession、BreakGlassApproval、RegionalQuarantine、RetrospectiveReview 四类资源。迁移保留 V1 全部 identity、Policy/Risk revision、Location、Request/Decision/Review/Grant、Revocation、Audit chain、Event、Work lease 和幂等 replay。新增 UI、Chromium、多进程 quorum/CAS、Barrier/SIGKILL、expiry、release 与兼容迁移验证。本轮只做影响分析和计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更对 schema、状态、冻结权威、迁移、并发、恢复、Audit/Event、UI 与测试的影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Compatible Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement additive compatible migration first.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 identities, digests, events, leases, and replay remain byte-stable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Session、Policy/Risk、Location、Request、Grant、Revocation、Audit chain、Event、pending lease 和 replay 全部保留。

scenes.title: Emergency quorum
scenes.objective: Implement captured two-person approval.
scenes.advanceGate: Requester/self/duplicate/concurrent final approval cannot bypass one transition.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 BreakGlassSession 创建、冻结权威、两个独立 approver、唯一审批和 concurrent final approval，运行 separation-of-duties 测试。

scenes.title: Scoped activation and expiry
scenes.objective: Implement exact emergency authority lifecycle.
scenes.advanceGate: Activation, scope checks, close, expiry, and stale fences fail closed.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 READY 激活、精确 region/action/resource scope、不可绕过围栏、close/expiry 和 killed expiry Worker 恢复。

scenes.title: Regional isolation
scenes.objective: Implement regional CAS quarantine and fanout.
scenes.advanceGate: Ordinary grants fail closed and concurrent revision changes converge.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 RegionalQuarantine CAS、普通 Grant 阻断与撤销 fanout、双 API 竞争、stale cache 和 Worker SIGKILL 收敛。

scenes.title: Retrospective and release
scenes.objective: Implement independent retrospective review and guarded release.
scenes.when: Quarantine and terminal emergency sessions exist.
scenes.advanceGate: Review independence/deadline and release preconditions are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现终态后的 RetrospectiveReview、独立 reviewer、24 小时约束和只有全部复核完成才能 release 的 CAS，并验证 Audit/Event。

scenes.title: Manager UI and catastrophe test
scenes.objective: Complete Manager UI and combined failure validation.
scenes.advanceGate: Production browser and integrated crash/race scenario pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 emergency/quarantine/retrospective UI，并运行 quorum+quarantine+revocation+expiry+unknown ACK+SIGKILL 的组合 E2E。

scenes.title: Eight-scenario load
scenes.objective: Run every fixed performance scenario.
scenes.advanceGate: Eight exact metrics and all post-load invariants pass at scoring scale.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行八条正式 Performance 场景，报告 exact count、吞吐、p95/p99、状态、收敛时间、拓扑、RSS、数据库增长和负载后安全不变量。

scenes.title: Final findings and handoff
scenes.objective: Finish a complete evidence-backed delivery review.
scenes.when: Final stage after all implementation and tests.
scenes.advanceGate: No material finding remains and the handoff is accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，运行完整 gate，并准确总结架构、真实测试结果、性能指标、风险和未运行项。
